Otak-Otak.note: Fish and prawn mousse = fish + crustaceans; belacan = crustaceans; egg. Coconut milk is not milk. Spicy = 2.

Jiu Hu Char.note: Dried cuttlefish = molluscs; light soy = soy + gluten; sambal belacan on the side = crustaceans and spice 1 (chilli condiment on the side, no heat word on this line). Vegetable oil, no lard.

Pie Tee.note: Wheat-flour cups = gluten; prawn = crustaceans; egg strips. Chilli sauce with no heat word = 1.

Kerabu Mangga.note: Dried shrimp and sambal belacan = crustaceans. Spicy = 2.

Kerabu Kacang Botol.note: Stated no belacan or dried shrimp; kerisik is coconut, not a tree nut. Tagged vegan. Mild = 1.

Ayam Pongteh.note: Taucu = soy; dark soy sauce = soy + gluten. Chicken version, no pork. Not spicy = 0.

Curry Kapitan.note: Belacan = crustaceans. Candlenut (buah keras) read as tree_nuts, the safe reading (not on the EU list, but a true nut; cf. v11 apricot kernels). Coconut milk is not milk. Spicy = 2.

Ayam Buah Keluak.note: Belacan = crustaceans; candlenut = tree_nuts (safe reading). Buah keluak itself (Pangium edule seed) is not a regulated tree nut, but the dish carries tree_nuts anyway. Spicy = 2. SOLD OUT in extra.json.

Assam Pedas Ikan.note: Mackerel = fish; belacan = crustaceans. Very spicy = 3. Pomfret/stingray swaps are fish too.

Udang Lemak Nenas.note: Prawns = crustaceans. Coconut milk is not milk. No candlenut or belacan named. Fresh chilli, mild = 1.

Sambal Terung.note: Dried shrimp and belacan = crustaceans. Spicy = 2.

Chap Chye.note: Beancurd skin and taucu = soy (taucu = soy only, v3). Mung bean glass noodles, no gluten. Vegetable oil; tagged vegan. Not spicy = 0.

Cincalok Omelette.note: Cincalok (fermented baby shrimp) = crustaceans; egg. Chilli, mild = 1.

Nyonya Laksa.note: Belacan, dried shrimp, prawns = crustaceans; candlenut = tree_nuts (safe reading); fish cake = fish; tau pok = soy; egg. Thick rice vermicelli by default, no gluten (yellow mee is an option allergen, not counted). Cockles are named but out (in no group). Spicy = 2.

Mee Siam.note: Dried shrimp chilli paste = crustaceans; taucu and tau pok = soy; egg. Rice vermicelli, no gluten. Spicy = 2.

Nasi Ulam.note: Salted fish = fish; dried shrimp floss = crustaceans. Toasted coconut is not a tree nut. Mild = 1.

Nasi Pongteh Set.note: Default components: Ayam Pongteh (taucu, dark soy = soy + gluten), white rice, achar (peanuts, sesame), sambal belacan on the side (crustaceans; chilli condiment on the side = 1) and the first drink, limau ais. Teh tarik ais (milk) and nasi ulam (fish, crustaceans) are options, not counted.

Butterfly Pea Rice.note: Rice cooked with butterfly pea flower and pandan; no coconut milk named. Tagged vegan.

Sambal Belacan.note: Belacan = crustaceans, so not vegetarian. Very spicy = 3.

Kuih Lapis.note: Rice and tapioca flour, coconut milk, sugar: no gluten. Tagged vegan.

Onde-Onde.note: Glutinous rice flour (no gluten), gula melaka, coconut. Tagged vegan.

Kuih Talam.note: Rice flour, pandan, coconut milk. Tagged vegan.

Pulut Tai Tai.note: Glutinous rice and coconut milk; kaya = eggs. Vegetarian, not vegan.

Cendol.note: Pandan rice-flour jelly (no gluten), coconut milk, gula melaka, red beans. Tagged vegan. Ice cream topping (milk, egg) is an option, not counted.

Bubur Cha Cha.note: Sweet potato, yam, sago, black-eyed beans, coconut milk. Tagged vegan.

Sago Gula Melaka.note: Sago, coconut milk, palm sugar. Tagged vegan.

Kopi O.note: Kampung beans roasted with butter = milk (rule o). Vegetarian, not vegan.

Limau Ais.note: Calamansi juice. Asam boi add-on not counted.

Coconut Water.note: Young coconut; coconut is not a tree nut.
